actions.manageUsers: Invite users, assign their roles and organizational units, deactivate their memberships
actions.manageClients: Create API clients, rotate and revoke their keys
actions.manageOrganizationalUnits: Create, retype, move and delete organizational units (what "in my units" covers)
actions.manageCustomFields: Add, change, reorder and deactivate custom fields (the fields administrators add to notes and other records)
actions.manageSettings: Set settings and feature flags for everyone, a unit or a user (platform/settings)
actions.manageTags: Create, rename, recolour and delete the tags records carry (platform/tags)
actions.manageLegalHolds: Place and release legal holds: records kept whatever a delete, a purge or a retention rule would do (iam/holds)
actions.manageRetention: Set how long the tenant keeps each kind of record before it is purged or anonymised (platform/retention)
actions.manageNamingSeries: Create, change and delete the number formats of numbered records, and set their counters (platform/sequences)
actions.manageCalendars: Create, change and delete the business calendars (working hours, time zone, holidays) that deadlines count in (platform/calendars)
actions.manageViews: Share saved views of lists with the whole tenant, and change or delete shared views (platform/views)
actions.manageTemplates: Share record templates with the whole tenant, and change or delete shared templates (platform/templates)
actions.manageTenants: Create tenants (the deployment's operators: only in the operator tenant)
actions.impersonate: Act as another user (support), never as an administrator
actions.manageSso: Set up the tenant's single sign-on: SAML and OpenID Connect connections, verified email domains
actions.provisionScim: Provision users and groups over SCIM 2.0 (API clients: the identity provider's SCIM token)

actions.breakGlass: Read any tenant without its invitation, for an hour at most, with a reason its administrators are told (break-glass; the deployment's operators: only in the operator tenant)

actions.read: See every approval request, not only one's own
actions.manage: Abandon an approved request whose outcome would not apply (POST /v1/approvals/{id}/abandon)

ofSubject.label: Of one subject
ofSubject.description: Only approval requests about records of this subject (Note).

actions.view: See the outbox, dead letters and live events
See the addresses mail is not sent to, and why
actions.manage: Add an address to the suppression list, or remove one

actions.read: See published forms and their versions
actions.submit: Fill in published forms, and see their own submissions
actions.edit: Create forms, edit their drafts, publish and archive them
actions.readResponses: See everyone's submissions and their answers

actions.restore: See deleted notes and restore them

note-publication.label: Note publication
note-publication.description: Publishes draft notes when their delay passes (or asks for approval first, for their owners).

mine.label: Created by me
mine.description: Only records this person (or API client) created.

inMyUnits.label: In my units
inMyUnits.description: Only records of the units I belong to.

inMyUnitsAndBelow.label: In my units and below
inMyUnitsAndBelow.description: Only records of the units I belong to, and of the units below them.

inUnitsILeadAndBelow.label: In units I lead and below
inUnitsILeadAndBelow.description: Only records of the units I lead, and of the units below them.

seed.label: First-boot seed
seed.description: Creates the built-in and declared roles and the first administrator on the first start.

audit-retention.label: Audit retention
audit-retention.description: Deletes audit entries older than AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS, every night.

soft-delete-purge.label: Recycle bin purge
soft-delete-purge.description: Deletes for good the records deleted longer ago than their retention, every night.

sign-up-tenant-sweep.label: Unverified sign-ups’ tenants
sign-up-tenant-sweep.description: Deletes the tenants self sign-ups made (TENANT_SIGN_UP) whose accounts never proved their address, every night.

tenant-deletion.label: Tenant deletion
tenant-deletion.description: Erases the tenants whose deletion grace period passed (their rows, files, queued jobs and workflows), every night.

sso.label: Single sign-on
sso.description: Fetches SSO connections' OpenID Connect discovery documents and checks the DNS records of the domains tenants verify.

account-deletion.label: Account deletion
account-deletion.description: Anonymizes the accounts whose deletion grace period passed, and erases their personal data, every night.

usage-rollup.label: Usage roll-up
usage-rollup.description: Copies API clients' daily usage counters from Redis into the database, every night.

attachment-sweep.label: Attachment sweep
attachment-sweep.description: Deletes the files and rows of attachments whose record no longer exists, and the files of direct uploads that were never completed, every night.

attachment-scan.label: Attachment malware scan
attachment-scan.description: Scans uploaded files for malware (MALWARE_SCANNER) and removes the infected ones.

attachment-images.label: Attachment image processing
attachment-images.description: Makes thumbnails and previews of uploaded images and removes the metadata (EXIF, GPS) of the originals.

attachment-text.label: Attachment text extraction
attachment-text.description: Extracts the text of uploaded documents (ATTACHMENT_TEXT_SEARCH) so that the search finds them.

revisions-retention.label: Revision retention
revisions-retention.description: Deletes record revisions older than REVISIONS_RETENTION_DAYS (never a record's latest), every night.

notification-retention.label: Notification retention
notification-retention.description: Deletes read notifications past NOTIFICATIONS_RETENTION_DAYS and any past NOTIFICATIONS_MAX_AGE_DAYS, every night.

recents-retention.label: Recent records retention
recents-retention.description: Deletes recently opened records older than 30 days, every night.

notification-digests.label: Notification digests
notification-digests.description: Mails the notification digests that are due, every hour.

notification-delivery.label: Notification delivery
notification-delivery.description: Delivers stored notifications through their channels (realtime, mail, webhook), from the outbox.

report-runner.label: Scheduled reports
report-runner.description: Starts the scheduled reports that are due (as their owners), pauses the ones that can no longer run, and records how each run ended.

record-schedules.label: Recurring record schedules
record-schedules.description: Creates the records of the recurring schedules that are due (as their owners), ends the schedules that can no longer run, and records the occurrences it skips.

approvals.label: Approvals
approvals.description: Runs approval requests' workflows: starts stages, reminds, escalates, expires, and applies the outcome.

exchange-rates.label: Exchange rates
exchange-rates.description: Fetches the ECB's euro reference rates once they are published each working day, and stores them.

mail-intake.label: Mail intake
mail-intake.description: Records the bounces and complaints a mail provider reports (SES through SNS) and keeps the suppression list from them.

mail-events-retention.label: Mail events retention
mail-events-retention.description: Deletes bounce, complaint and delivery events older than MAIL_EVENTS_RETENTION_DAYS, every night.

webhook-delivery-retention.label: Webhook delivery retention
webhook-delivery-retention.description: Deletes outgoing webhook deliveries that finished more than WEBHOOKS_DELIVERY_RETENTION_DAYS ago, with their attempt log and recorded requests (never one still being retried), every night.

outbox-retention.label: Outbox retention
outbox-retention.description: Deletes outbox dead letters older than OUTBOX_DEAD_LETTER_RETENTION_DAYS and consumers' inbox records older than OUTBOX_INBOX_RETENTION_DAYS, every night.

platform-analytics.label: Platform analytics
platform-analytics.description: Counts tenants, users, memberships and API use across every tenant, withholds small groups, and stores only the aggregates the reporting role reads, every night.

reencryption.label: Re-encryption
reencryption.description: Rewrites encrypted values and blind indexes still under an older key with the current one, in batches, every hour.

retention.label: Retention
retention.description: Purges or anonymises the records past the retention rules a tenant turned on, in batches, skipping records under a legal hold, every night.

messaging.label: Push and SMS delivery
messaging.description: Sends the SMS and push messages notifications queued, within the toll-fraud caps.

messaging-inbound.label: Inbound SMS
messaging-inbound.description: Records a number opting out (STOP) or back in (START) from the SMS provider webhook.

messaging-retention.label: Messaging retention
messaging-retention.description: Removes devices not seen for DEVICES_RETENTION_DAYS and the toll-fraud counters of past days, every night.

demo-seed.label: Demo seed
demo-seed.description: Creates demo users, organizational units and the features' demo data on a development database (pnpm db:seed:demo); refuses any other.

ops.label: Operator CLI
ops.description: Break-glass commands run on a server (pnpm ops): a one-time password, removing two-factor, unlocking an account, deleting a setting, creating an administrator.
